SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-SQ-03: SQL-on-FHIR Analytics Layer — Cross-package integration (SQLQuery ↔ ViewDefinition ↔ SQLView), Error model integration, Public API surface. Test these items: One-level chain: SQLQuery with one relatedArtifact pointing at a ViewDefinition canonical — materializes VD as view, raw SQL body resolves alias correctly, Two-level chain: SQLQuery → SQLView → ViewDefinition — recursive materialization produces correct rows, Cycle: SQLView A depends on SQLView B depends on SQLView A — SQLQueryCycleError raised before execution, Resolver contract: ViewDefinition dict detected structurally (has 'select' + 'resource' keys), Resolver contract: Library dict detected by resourceType='Library'; parsed ViewDefinition/SQLQuery/SQLView objects handled via isinstance, Resolver failure (any exception) translated to SQLQueryMaterializationError with label + canonical context, Identifier quoting: relatedArtifact.label and parameter.name validated against sql-name and quoted via viewdef.utils.quote_identifier before reaching DuckDB, Error model integration: SQLError inherits from viewdef.errors.SQLOnFHIRError; except SQLOnFHIRError catches all SQLQuery errors transitively, All SQLQuery errors also inherit from ValueError for backward-compat, One-way dependency: fhir4ds/viewdef/ never imports fhir4ds/sqlquery/, Public API surface: parse_library, parse_sqlquery, parse_sqlview, validate_sql_library, select_best_content, SQLQueryRunner, DependencyResolver type alias. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.
